turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Hi there, thanks for holding, how are you doing today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yeah not bad thanks, bit busy but good.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: This call is being recorded for quality and compliance purposes.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Good to hear. So I'm just calling about the energy plan you enquired about.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Oh right, yeah, go ahead.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Uh, sorry, one sec, let me just pull up your details here.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No worries, take your time.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Okay, got it, thanks for bearing with me.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: That's alright.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Can I confirm I'm speaking with the account holder listed on the bill?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yep, that's me.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Can you confirm the supply address for me?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Forty Angas Street, Adelaide, South Australia, 5000.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: And just for security, can I get your date of birth?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The ninth of September, nineteen eighty.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Great, and I've got your NMI here as well, just confirming that's correct.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So looking at your usage, we reckon this plan would suit you pretty well.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay sounds good.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Great, so let me just run through a few details with you first.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: This plan's estimated annual cost is compared against the Default Market Offer set by the Australian Energy Regulator for your distribution zone.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So your peak usage rate on this plan works out to

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: twenty eight point six cents per kilowatt hour.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: And the daily supply charge is

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: ninety eight point five cents a day.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay that sounds fine.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Can I just read back your email to confirm we've got it right?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: B dot singh at example dot com, is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yep that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: You have a ten business day cooling-off period during which you can cancel this agreement at no cost.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: We'll email you the full terms and conditions along with your welcome pack.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Alright, I think that covers everything from my end.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yep sounds good, thanks.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Great, thanks so much for your time today, have a good one.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: You too, bye.
